youtube_description:
The Rocky Mountains Of Europe? Switzerland is well known all over the world as a paradise for hiking. We, Deen and Alette, from Hikaholics are here to show you Europes beauty. This time we will take you with us on a hike through the Swiss Rockies! 

Translated this mountain range is called The Devils Mountains, because two immense landslides occurred in the 17 hundreds, which back then the people considered the work of the devil. 
 
We are hiking a 7km trail that starts at Lake Derborence. With only 300 meters of elevation gain this hike is considered pretty easy. We are joined by our Swiss friends, Manuel and Jasmine 

Let’s see if this area is hikers heaven or devils dungeon!

Click on this link to go to Manuel's IG: https://www.instagram.com/manuelkalasse/ 
Go to the YT channel from the amazing chef Jasmine: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC1OG_NjmLkQ6KnWrFb9kUQg
